title: PVA Systems SCADA - Deployment Simulator Rules & Failure Signatures
description: Knowledge base of all known CI/CD, WebAssembly, and Vercel deployment failure modes, their detection patterns, and mitigation strategies.

rules.name: Git Untracked File Invariant
rules.description: Files referenced in CMakeLists.txt or PVA_VPU50_SCADA.qrc must be tracked in Git. Untracked files exist locally but are missing on GitHub Actions checkout.
rules.failure_symptom: fatal error: <file>: No such file or directory during GitHub Actions build_wasm step
rules.detection: Check git status --porcelain for '??' on any file registered in CMakeLists.txt or PVA_VPU50_SCADA.qrc.
rules.remediation: Run 'git add <file>' to track the file before pushing.

rules.name: Zero Duplicate QML/Resource Entries
rules.description: Every file entry in PVA_VPU50_SCADAContent/CMakeLists.txt and PVA_VPU50_SCADA.qrc must appear exactly once.
rules.failure_symptom: error: redefinition of 'unit' during qmlcachegen WebAssembly compilation
rules.detection: Parse all quoted strings in CMakeLists.txt QML_FILES/RESOURCES and all <file> tags in PVA_VPU50_SCADA.qrc and assert set(files) == files.
rules.remediation: Remove duplicate file entries from the corresponding CMakeLists.txt or .qrc file.

rules.name: Zero Ephemeral or Scratch Paths
rules.description: Never include files from scratch/, tmp/, .temp/, or output_frames/ in CMakeLists.txt, PVA_VPU50_SCADA.qrc, or qds.cmake.
rules.failure_symptom: CMake Error: File does not exist: scratch/<filename>
rules.detection: Regex scan for 'scratch/' or 'tmp/' in all CMake and QRC manifests.
rules.remediation: Remove scratch references or relocate production code into components/ or screens/.

rules.name: Zero Non-Existent File References
rules.description: Every file declared in CMakeLists.txt and PVA_VPU50_SCADA.qrc must physically exist on the local disk.
rules.failure_symptom: ninja: error: '<file>', needed by '<target>', missing and no known rule to make it
rules.detection: Verify os.path.exists() for every declared file relative to the project root.
rules.remediation: Either create the missing file or remove its declaration from the build manifest.

rules.name: CMake Root Project Target Collision Invariant
rules.description: The root CMakeLists.txt project name must not collide with subdirectory target library names.
rules.failure_symptom: add_library cannot create target 'PVA_VPU50_SCADA' because another target with the same name already exists
rules.detection: Verify root project() is named 'PVA_VPU50_SCADAApp' rather than 'PVA_VPU50_SCADA'.
rules.remediation: Set project(PVA_VPU50_SCADAApp LANGUAGES CXX) in root CMakeLists.txt.

rules.name: Vercel WebAssembly Security Headers
rules.description: vercel.json must include Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp, plus Content-Type: application/wasm.
rules.failure_symptom: SharedArrayBuffer is not defined; WebAssembly 60 FPS canvas fails to initialize in modern browsers
rules.detection: Parse vercel.json headers array and verify COOP, COEP, and wasm MIME type rules exist.
rules.remediation: Update vercel.json with the required security headers.

rules.name: Vercel Dist Packaging Structure
rules.description: The distribution directory (dist/) must contain index.html, valid web assets, favicon, and vercel.json.
rules.failure_symptom: CRITICAL: dist/index.html was not generated! Aborting deployment on GitHub Actions runner
rules.detection: Verify dist/index.html exists, is > 100 bytes, and contains HTML markup.
rules.remediation: Ensure build output copy script copies html, js, wasm, and renames target to index.html.

rules.name: QML Declarative Rule in .ui.qml
rules.description: Files ending with .ui.qml must be strictly declarative. No imperative functions, loops, or complex JS constructors.
rules.failure_symptom: Qt Design Studio Error M222 or compilation failure in qmlcachegen
rules.detection: Regex scan .ui.qml files for 'function ' declarations or forbidden JS calls.
rules.remediation: Move imperative logic into the corresponding .qml logic wrapper.

rules.name: QML File Shadowing Invariant
rules.description: Never have identical base names for a .ui.qml file and a .qml file in the same directory (e.g. Foo.ui.qml and Foo.qml).
rules.failure_symptom: The declarative .ui.qml shadows the .qml logic file; timers and signals are bypassed in WebAssembly
rules.detection: Check for files with the exact same base name differing only by .ui.qml vs .qml.
rules.remediation: Name the declarative file FooView.ui.qml and instantiate it inside Foo.qml.

rules.name: QML Headless Engine Clean Instantiation
rules.description: The entire QML tree rooted at App.qml must instantiate headlessly with PySide6 QQmlApplicationEngine with ZERO fatal warnings or missing singletons.
rules.failure_symptom: Module 'theme' does not contain a type... or ReferenceError: Foo is not defined at runtime
rules.detection: Run QQmlApplicationEngine offscreen, capture QML warnings, and assert engine.rootObjects() has count > 0.
rules.remediation: Fix missing singleton registration in qmldir or broken import paths.
